'''Viktor Korolev''' ({{langx|ru|Ви́ктор Юрьевич Королёв}}) (born 1954) is a Russian scientist in the field of mathematical statistics, [[Professor (highest academic rank)|Professor]], [[Doctor of Science|Dr. Sc.]], a professor at the [[MSU CMC|Faculty of Computer Science at the Moscow State University]].<ref>[http://letopis.msu.ru/peoples/5037 Annals of the Moscow University]{{in lang|ru}}</ref><ref>[https://cs.msu.ru/persons/653 MSU CMC]{{in lang|ru}}</ref>

He defended the thesis «Limit distributions of random sequences with independent random indices and some of their applications» for the degree of [[Doctor of Science|Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences]] (1994).

He has authored 27 books and more than 340 scientific articles.<ref name="istina">{{cite web|url=http://istina.msu.ru/profile/V_Korolev/|title=Королев Виктор Юрьевич - пользователь, сотрудник &#124; ИСТИНА – Интеллектуальная Система Тематического Исследования НАукометрических данных|trans-title=Korolev Viktor Yurievich &#124; Intellectual System of Thematic Research of NAUmetric data|website=istina.msu.ru|accessdate=2018-05-22}}</ref><ref>[http://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?personid=30438&option_lang=&option_lang=eng Scientific works of Viktor Korolev]{{in lang|en}}</ref>
